items.title: Is this a WIN or a DRAW? 🤔 Fastest stalemate ever #chess
items.desc:
The shortest known stalemate, composed by Sam Loyd: 1.e3 a5 2.Qh5 Ra6 3.Qxa5 h5 4.h4 Rah6 5.Qxc7 f6 6.Qxd7+ Kf7 7.Qxb7 Qd3 8.Qxb8 Qh7 9.Qxc8 Kg6 10.Qe6 - stalemate!

Black has pieces left but none can move, and the king isn't in check.

Did you know a game could end like this? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Trapped by his OWN rooks 🤦 Epaulette Mate #chesspuzzle
items.desc:
White to move: mate in 1. Pause and find it!

Answer: Qe6# - the black rooks on d8 and f8 block the king's escape. It's called the EPAULETTE MATE because the rooks sit on the king's shoulders.

Did you find it? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Chess Rule #4: Can the kings touch? 🤔 #chess
items.desc:
Chess Rule #4: can a king walk right next to the other king? NEVER - two kings can't stand next to each other, because each one would be in check. This face-off is called the opposition.

Did you know this? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Chess Rule #5: Extra bishop... and it's a DRAW? 🤔 #chess
items.desc:
Chess Rule #5: White has an extra bishop. Is it a win? NO - king and bishop can't checkmate, so the game is an instant draw. Same with king and knight.

Did you know this? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Chess Rule #6: Can the king take the queen? 🤔 #chess
items.desc:
Chess Rule #6: the queen checks right next to the king. Can the king take it? NO - the rook protects it, and a king can never capture into check. Kf1 is the only legal move.

Did you know this? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Chess Rule #7: The knight is pinned... does it still count? 🤔 #chess
items.desc:
Chess Rule #7: White's knight is pinned. So can Black's king walk to c4, a square the knight covers? NO - a pinned piece still attacks. The king can never step onto a square it covers.

Did you know this? YES or NO 👇

items.title: Chess Rule #8: Down 2 rooks... and still SAVED 😳 #chess
items.desc:
Chess Rule #8: Black is up TWO rooks. Can White still save the game? YES - Qe8+ and Qh5+ forever. The king can't escape, and when the same position appears three times it's a draw by repetition.

Did you know this? YES or NO 👇
